exposure: first blood pressure level of more than 180/120 mmHg
number of antenatal care visits of less than eight times
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with severe pre-eclampsia who delivered at Pattani Provincial Hospital between July 2021 and April 2023.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus and poor antenatal care (less than eight visits) were associated with an increased risk of pulmonary edema among severe pre-eclamptic women.
